messages:
mike: saw a surge of kms.wrap_failure in prod around 15:14 UTC, tied to svc-deployer-onboard SA. tagging @tara @alice
tara: can you paste the redacted log?
mike: { "ts": "2026-03-25T15:14:02Z", "event": "kms.wrap_failure", "key": "projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/llm-wrap", "principal": "svc-deployer-onboard@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com", "error": "entropy_low" }
alice: likely client RNG; did the latest agent bundle a custom PRNG? infra-bot, any image changes?
infra-bot: deploy deployer-agent v3.0 to prod at 2026-03-25T14:50Z. No KMS policy edits recorded.
tara: triage plan: 1) repro in staging with SA (alice), 2) deploy temporary entropy check + restart hook on prod hosts (tara), 3) enable verbose KMS audit export for 3h (mike)
alice: repro in staging only when artificially starving entropy. switching to getrandom() fixes it. opening PR to fallback to OS RNG.
tara: rolling a small canary watchdog that checks /proc/sys/kernel/random/entropy_avail < 250 and restarts onboarding container if low. will run on 5 hosts first. ETA 20m.
mike: created SEC-TRIAGE-507. do not rotate llm-wrap key unless we observe malformed wrap payloads or unauthorized unwraps. record approver before any rotation.
security-bot: alert rule created: kms.wrap_failure spike > 40 in 30m (prod). will page #incidents on breach.
mike: thanks all. keep updates short here.
